items.text: if you scrap the ground you will remove all the O2 from the vincinity. also turns out there's 0 consequence for committing mass murder by way of asphyxiation
items.text_zh: 如果你拆解地面，你会移除附近所有的O2。另外事实证明，通过窒息方式实施大规模谋杀是0后果的。
